title: Design quiz
blurb: A few quick questions so I build the details the way you actually want them. No wrong answers, and nothing here is binding.

questions.title: Window & door trim
questions.note: Same window, same wall, same paint. Only the casing changes.

options.label: Square cut
options.note: Flat boards, square ends, a plain header on top

options.label: 22° angle
options.note: Header ends cut back, a gentle flare

options.label: 45° angle
options.note: The same cut, steeper and more pronounced

options.label: Craftsman cap
options.note: A thick cap over the header, with a shadow line under it

options.label: Standard casing
options.note: Milled profile, mitred corners, the conventional look

options.label: Picture frame
options.note: Flat boards mitred all the way round. Clean and modern

options.label: Victorian
options.note: Fluted casing with turned rosettes at the corners

questions.title: Interior doors
questions.note: Same opening, same casing. Only the door changes.

options.label: Flat slab
options.note: No panels at all, flush and modern

options.label: Two panel
options.note: Two recessed panels, quiet and current

options.label: Three panel
options.note: A little more detail, still simple

options.label: Five panel
options.note: What most houses round here were built with

options.label: Six panel
options.note: Raised panels with a moulded edge. The traditional one

options.label: Glass, ten lite
options.note: Lets light through to the next room

questions.title: Baseboards
questions.note: Shown turning a corner, so you can see the profile end-on.

options.label: 3½ inch square
options.note: Flat and plain. Disappears into the room

options.label: 3¼ inch colonial
options.note: The standard profile most houses have

options.label: 5¼ inch craftsman
options.note: A flat board with a cap. Reads as deliberate

options.label: 7¼ inch craftsman
options.note: Taller again. Suits an older house with high ceilings

options.label: 9 inch built-up
options.note: Board, cap and shoe. Formal, and substantial

questions.title: Crown moulding
questions.note: Looking up into the corner where the walls meet the ceiling.

options.label: None
options.note: A clean line where wall meets ceiling

options.label: Simple cove
options.note: One small curve. Quiet

options.label: Colonial crown
options.note: The classic S-shaped profile

options.label: Large crown
options.note: The same shape, bigger. Suits a high ceiling

options.label: Built up
options.note: Crown over a frieze board. For a formal room

questions.title: Wainscoting
questions.note: What goes on the lower part of the wall.

options.label: Plain wall
options.note: Just baseboard. Nothing added

options.label: Beadboard
options.note: Narrow boards with a bead. Cottage, bathroom, porch

options.label: Board & batten
options.note: Flat panel with battens. Simple and graphic

options.label: Picture frame
options.note: Applied moulding boxes. Dressy without being heavy

options.label: Raised panel
options.note: Full panelled wainscot. Formal

options.label: Shiplap
options.note: Horizontal boards, floor to ceiling

questions.title: Built-ins & shelving
questions.note: Same wall, same books. Only the joinery changes.

options.label: Open bookcase
options.note: Shelves all the way up, nothing hidden

options.label: Cabinets below
options.note: Closed storage underneath, shelves above

options.label: Glass-front uppers
options.note: Doors you can see through, over cabinets

options.label: Floating shelves
options.note: Thick oak shelves on the wall, no frame at all

options.label: Library wall
options.note: Floor to ceiling, with a rolling ladder

questions.title: Fireplace mantel
questions.note: Same firebox and slate. Only the mantel changes.

options.label: Rustic beam
options.note: One heavy timber shelf, nothing else

options.label: Craftsman
options.note: Flat legs, a frieze, and a shelf on corbels

options.label: Colonial
options.note: Fluted pilasters and crown under the shelf

options.label: To the ceiling
options.note: A full surround with panelling above the shelf

questions.title: Deck railing
questions.note: Same posts and rails. Only what fills the gap changes.

options.label: Black metal
options.note: Thin balusters, least in the way of a view

options.label: Wood balusters
options.note: Square painted spindles, the traditional one

options.label: Cable
options.note: Nearly invisible from a few feet back

options.label: Horizontal slat
options.note: Boards run sideways. More privacy, more shade

options.label: Glass panel
options.note: Nothing at all between you and the yard

options.label: Natural cedar
options.note: Warm and light. Goes silver if you leave it

options.label: Treated pine, stained
options.note: The budget-friendly one, stained honey

options.label: Grey composite
options.note: No staining, ever. Cool and even

options.label: Brown composite
options.note: No staining, ever. Warm and dark

options.label: Ipe hardwood
options.note: Dense tropical hardwood that lasts for decades

questions.title: Porch ceiling
questions.note: Looking up from the porch toward the street.

options.label: Stained
options.note: Warm, and hides a lot

options.label: Painted white
options.note: Bounces light back down onto the porch

options.label: Natural cedar
options.note: Left to go its own colour over time

options.label: Haint blue
options.note: The Southern one. Pale blue-green

options.label: White beadboard
options.note: Narrower boards with a bead

options.label: Knotty pine
options.note: Clear-coated, knots and all

questions.title: Porch columns
questions.note: Same porch, same beam. Only the column changes.

options.label: Square box
options.note: Straight and square, trimmed top and bottom

options.label: Craftsman on brick
options.note: A tapered column standing on a brick pier

options.label: Round Tuscan
options.note: The classic round column, gently swelled

options.label: Turned post
options.note: Victorian spindle, slimmer and more ornate

options.label: Timber post
options.note: Rough-sawn cedar on a black steel base

questions.title: Fence
questions.note: Same posts, same yard. Only the boards change.

options.label: Privacy
options.note: Tight vertical boards. Nothing gets through

options.label: Shadowbox
options.note: Boards alternate sides. Air gets through, eyes don't

options.label: Horizontal
options.note: Sideways boards with small gaps. Modern

options.label: Picket
options.note: Painted, pointed, waist high. The front-yard one

options.label: Capped
options.note: Board-on-board with a cap and trim. Finished-looking

questions.title: Hardware finish
questions.note: Whatever you pick, every handle in the room should match it.

options.label: Matte black
options.note: High contrast, very current

options.label: Satin brass
options.note: Warm and soft, and ages well

options.label: Polished brass
options.note: Bright and traditional

options.label: Brushed nickel
options.note: Quiet, and hides fingerprints

options.label: Polished chrome
options.note: Bright, cool and mirror-like

options.label: Oil-rubbed bronze
options.note: Dark brown, softer than black

questions.title: Handle style
questions.note: All in satin brass, so only the shape changes.

options.label: Round knob
options.note: The classic. Fits anywhere

options.label: Straight lever
options.note: Clean and modern. Easy with full hands

options.label: Curved lever
options.note: A traditional lever with a soft return

options.label: Glass knob
options.note: Faceted glass. Vintage, and catches the light

options.label: Square lever
options.note: Square rose, square lever. Very modern
